summary: GMR Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the entry into several agreements in connection with its IPO of Class A common stock. The filings include an Underwriting Agreement with J.P. Morgan, a Registration Rights Agreement, a Tax Receivable Agreement, a Stockholders Agreement, a Private Placement Investment Agreement, and an Exchange Agreement. The terms mirror those in the previously filed registration statement. This is a routine IPO-related current report and does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign.
